notes: Emergency archival resume: resumeEmergencyArchival takes a durable provider-job record at GENERATED_TEMPORARY/ARCHIVING and drives the EXACT persisted provider URL into an injected hosted-ingest port (GHL-005 adapter; no credentials here, GHL-001 owns auth). One attempt per call, no retry loop (GHL-011 owns bounded retry around the port), no submit/poll/generate capability anywhere in the module so regeneration is structurally impossible. Gates: wrong entry state -> EmergencyArchivalError INVALID_ENTRY_STATE (ARCHIVED never re-archived, SUBMITTED/GENERATING belong to the poll runner); missing/blank URL -> BLOCKED MISSING_PROVIDER_URL; non-http(s) or unparseable URL -> BLOCKED URL_INVALID; parseable expiresAt <= now (injectable clock) -> BLOCKED EXPIRED_URL with NO network attempt; probe non-2xx/timeout -> BLOCKED URL_UNREACHABLE (status preserved); hosted ingest throw/non-ARCHIVED result -> BLOCKED HOSTED_INGEST_FAILED carrying the ingest error. Unparseable/absent expiration treated as unknown -> decided by probe, never trusted as expired. Every BLOCKED outcome is a returned union member (not an exception) carrying machine-readable reason, preserved providerTaskId, ISO blockedAt, and a documented nextAction from EMERGENCY_BLOCK_NEXT_ACTIONS (all end with 'Never regenerate automatically'), so the caller persists the documented BLOCKED state per spec 18/runbook 14.4.
